shared_elements: dense low-relief/engraved decoration filling the field
bilaterally symmetrical composition about a vertical axis
band(s) of inscribed signs / script-like characters
justification: Both surfaces are vertical fields with symmetrical, densely curling ornament and rows of sign-like characters, but that is about as generic as decorative correspondence gets. A shows a frontal anthropomorphic figure in elaborate costume carved in deep three-dimensional relief filling the whole shaft, while B shows a flat, purely linear cross-shaped foliate emblem set below three horizontal lines of alphabetic-looking text, with no figure at all.
